messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I actually need some help with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check which address it was sent to, the tracking number, and whether it’s still on the way? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s, so I don’t have to change it every time I send her something.

Absolutely—I can help with all of that. First, I’ll need to authenticate your account so I can access the order and your saved address.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address** (preferred), or  
2) Your **first name + last name + ZIP code**

Also, to check tracking + the shipping address the order went to, please share the **order id** (it looks like `#W0000000`).  

Finally, for the tablet storage size check, tell me **either**:
- the **product name** you ordered (e.g., “tablet”), **and** the storage you’re trying to confirm, **or**
- the **item id** from your order details (if you have it)

Once I have the email and order id, I can look up:
- where it was shipped to,
- the tracking number and current status,
- and the tablet’s storage/variant.  

And if you still want to update your **default shipping address to your daughter’s**, I’ll ask you to confirm the new address details before I make any changes.

Sure, I can give you my name and ZIP code. It’s Lucas Santos, and my ZIP code is 80239. 

I don’t have the order ID handy right now—could you maybe look it up with my name? I ordered a tablet and a couple of other things for my daughter in Chicago. The tablet is the main thing I’m worried about; I just want to make sure it’s the 128GB version.

And yes, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s in Chicago, but I’ll wait for you to ask for the details. 

By the way, thanks for helping me out. I don’t get to talk to many people these days, so I appreciate you taking the time.
